import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt() {
            val = 0;
        }

        ModInt(long v) {
            v = v % MOD + MOD;
            val = (int)(v % MOD);
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = (v % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(val);
        }
    }

    static ModInt add(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        return new ModInt((a.val + b.val) % MOD);
    }

    static ModInt sub(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        return new ModInt((a.val - b.val + MOD) % MOD);
    }

    static ModInt mul(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        return new ModInt((int)(((long)a.val * b.val) % MOD));
    }

    static ModInt[] fact = new ModInt[1024000];
    static ModInt[] invFact = new ModInt[1024000];

    static void initFactorials(int n) {
        fact[0] = new ModInt(1);
        invFact[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            fact[i] = mul(fact[i-1], new ModInt(i));
            invFact[i] = div(invFact[i-1], new ModInt(i));
        }
    }

    static ModInt div(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        return mul(a, modPow(b, MOD - 2));
    }

    static ModInt modPow(ModInt base, int exp) {
        ModInt res = new ModInt(1);
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = mul(res, base);
            base = mul(base, base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static ModInt comb(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return new ModInt(0);
        return mul(mul(fact[n], invFact[r]), invFact[n - r]);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;

        ModInt[][] pers = new ModInt[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                pers[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < s; ++i) {
            pers[i][i] = new ModInt(1);
        }

        for (int i = s; i < s + N; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = s; j < s + N; ++j) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                pers[i][j] = div(new ModInt(p), new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        for (int i = s + N; i < 6; ++i) {
            pers[i][i] = new ModInt(1);
        }

        // Generate all permutations of {0,0,0,1,1,1}
        int[] v = {0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1};
        Map<Integer, Integer> permMap = new HashMap<>();
        int id = 0;
        do {
            int mask = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                if (v[k] == 1) mask |= (1 << k);
            }
            permMap.put(mask, id++);
        } while (nextPermutation(v));

        int upperSize = 1 << 20;
        ModInt[] upper = solve(pers, 0);
        ModInt[] lower = solve(pers, 3);

        // FWT-style summation for lower
        for (int bit = 1; bit < upperSize; bit <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < upperSize; ++i) {
                if ((i & bit) == 0) {
                    lower[i ^ bit] = add(lower[i ^ bit], lower[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < upperSize; ++mask) {
            if (upper[mask].val == 0) continue;

            int need = 0;
            for (int x = 0; x < 20; ++x) {
                if ((mask & (1 << x)) != 0) {
                    need |= (1 << (19 - x));
                }
            }

            int complement = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ need;
            ModInt term = mul(upper[mask], sub(new ModInt(1), lower[complement]));
            answer = add(answer, term);
        }

        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }

    static ModInt[] solve(ModInt[][] pers, int offset) {
        int upperSize = 1 << 20;
        ModInt[] result = new ModInt[upperSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < upperSize; ++i) {
            result[i] = new ModInt(0);
        }

        int totalBits = 18;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << totalBits); ++mask) {
            int[][] haves = new int[3][6];
            ModInt prob = new ModInt(1);

            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    int idx = i * 6 + j;
                    if ((mask & (1 << idx)) != 0) {
                        haves[i][j] = 1;
                        prob = mul(prob, pers[offset + i][j]);
                    } else {
                        prob = mul(prob, sub(new ModInt(1), pers[offset + i][j]));
                    }
                }
            }

            int flags = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
                if (haves[0][i] == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    if (haves[1][j] == 0) continue;
                    if (i == j) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                        if (haves[2][k] == 0) continue;
                        if (i == k || j == k) continue;
                        int anum = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                        if (permMap.containsKey(anum)) {
                            flags |= (1 << permMap.get(anum));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            result[flags] = add(result[flags], prob);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) {
            j--;
        }

        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;

        reverse(arr, i + 1, arr.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = arr[start];
            arr[start] = arr[end];
            arr[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
}
